project.heading: About
project.text: Cinematic Hyperwheel is an experimental project exploring "harmony beyond similarity" in movie recommendations — using PCA over the MovieLens Tag Genome to suggest movies that are deliberately different from a reference, yet resonate with it in spirit, the way complementary or triadic colors relate on a color wheel.
